items.statement: Overdraft utilization has been higher for past few months, tapering down towards end of Q4 FY25

In terms of utilization, overdraft facilities are usually taken from the banks for these purposes that whenever there is an outflow which is required to be done in terms of trade payables and all, the utilization is on the higher side and again it tapers down towards the end of the fourth quarter.

items.quote: Yes, we are looking to start the process in this Q4 quarter and all for the rights money in next few months. But the process will be started in this quarter as we had committed earlier.

items.statement: Rights issue final tranche will be called in current quarter as per original three-tranche roadmap
items.quote: Having said that, I think the rights issue final tranche will be called in this quarter.

items.statement: Cash and equivalents at end of Q3 FY25 were INR7,395 million, up from INR7,201 million in Q2 FY25 and INR7,179 million a year ago.
items.quote: Cash and equivalents at the end of the quarter was INR7,395 million versus INR7,201 million in Q2 FY '25 and INR7,179 million last year.

items.statement: DSO increased to 68 days in Q3 FY25 from 59 days a year ago and 56 days last quarter due to higher billing volume.
items.quote: DSO was slightly higher at 68 days compared to 59 days last year and 56 days last quarter due to increased billing volume in Q3.

items.statement: CFO Ashish Lakhotia stepped down at close of business yesterday; new CFO expected to onboard within current financial year
items.quote: Finally, Mr. Ashish Lakhotia, who joined us as Deputy CFO in August 2023 and has been our CFO since February 2024, has stepped down from his duties at the close of business hours yesterday. We anticipate onboarding a new CFO within the current financial year.

items.statement: Cash balance increased from INR 93 crores at end of September to INR 132 crores at end of December 2024; roughly half from operations, balance from facility sale
items.quote: Our cash balance, which stood at INR 93 crores at the end of September, now stands at INR 132 crores at the end of December 2024. Roughly half of this increase came out of operations with the balance coming from the facility sales.

items.statement: Company generates INR 15-18 crores operating cash per quarter; expects to reach close to INR 150 crores cash by year-end
items.quote: Because typically we generate between INR 15 crores to INR 18 crores of operating cash every quarter. So I foresee us very, very close to the mark that we had guided to.

items.statement: Company maintains ~17% of assets as cash and equivalents for liquidity
items.quote: We have been maintaining about 17% of assets as cash and equivalents, which provides us with enough liquidity to meet all the organizational obligations.

items.statement: Board approved raising up to INR750 crores of confidence capital
items.quote: The Board, taking in view the future growth has given an approval to raise up to INR750 crores of confidence capital.

items.statement: Board approved equity raise of up to INR750 crores as confidence capital; mode and timing to be decided; promoter support confirmed
items.quote: We had a Board today, and the Board has approved of equity raise of up to about INR750 crores, which is the confidence capital that you spoke about.

items.statement: Granted 60,000 stock options representing 0.5% of outstanding share capital as part of 2.5% ESOP pool
items.quote: We have granted 60,000 stock options, representing 0.5% of our current outstanding share capital as a part of our 2.5% ESOP pool.

items.statement: Ethanol plant running at optimum capacity with 29,724 KL allocation from OMCs for 2024-25 supply year
items.quote: Our ethanol plant is currently running at optimum capacity and we have successfully secured tenders from OMC with an allocation of 29,724 kiloliters of ethanol for the estimate supply year of '24-'25.
